## Interpretation: spatial features and tree importance

The [pass-selection](vignettes/03_transition_model/03_transition_model.ipynb),
[action-selection](vignettes/04_action_selection/04_action_selection.ipynb) and
[residual-risk](vignettes/05a_residual_risk/05a_residual_risk.ipynb) vignettes now
show conceptual-input split importance for their frozen production and outer
ensembles. These explain model use, not new performance benchmarks or causal
effects. The [BCOS extra](vignettes/extras/bcos/10_bcos.ipynb) additionally reports
fixed-model held-out perturbations. Its relevance motivates testing richer
descriptions of accessible-space shape for continuation risk, without assuming
that an improvement will follow. Compare a small current-state feature block
on identical match folds, using validation selection and held-out CE/calibration.
No such extension is included in the final models.
